summary: Not sure we need a web 3.0 maybe we took wrong lesson from web 2.0 when we said "now no one needs to know HTML to get online" and this lead to centralized platform. Maybe we should have said, "Maybe now it's time to teach everyone HTML" #el30
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Not sure we need a web 3.0 maybe we took wrong lesson from web 2.0 when we said "now no one needs to know HTML to get online" and this lead to centralized platform.

Maybe we should have said, "Maybe now it's time to teach everyone HTML" #el30
